end_to_end.warmups: One CRF27 run per method and content
end_to_end.curve: One complete four-point curve per method and content
end_to_end.order: Rotate methods by CRF index and extra repeat index
end_to_end.timing: Complete process wall time including startup and the same local original source file
end_to_end.metrics: Strict complete FFmpeg decode, exact integer Y/U/V SSE, PSNR-Y, PCHIP BD-rate on the common quality interval without extrapolation
end_to_end.aggregation: Median paired CRF27 percentage changes per content, then equal-content means; all observations retained

fixed_state.capture: Every filtered I/P frame, original anchor and padded references, motion fields, unchanged full LUTs, rebuilt reduced-range LUTs, expected full output
fixed_state.timing: Planning, compensation, fusion and any checked-window verification; excludes capture, I/O, supplied table construction, auditing and hashing
fixed_state.audit: All pixels once per method and tolerance; full and full4 must match captured pixels; certified methods must satisfy tolerance
fixed_state.aggregation: Median of paired per-round summed frame-time changes, then equal-content means

settings.filtered_types: I and P only; dedicated MCTF lowres ME fields; original lookahead planes and cost caches remain unchanged
settings.kernel: Exact eight-pixel NEON for every main method; four-pixel full control
settings.off_control: Unmodified pinned upstream x264 executable, with no MCTF options

failure_policy: Stop on decode/frame mismatch, nondeterminism, changed binary/source, invalid arithmetic, or certificate violation. Preserve failed attempts; no outcome-based rerun or exclusion.
concurrency: One encoder or replay at a time. No compilation, sanitizer runs, PDF rendering or plotting during measured jobs.
